guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 雙曲率拱壩與原水品質取水。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Double curvature arch support and raw water withdrawal. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 官方列出翡翠大壩高度為 122.5 m
1987 年公開紀錄：翡翠水庫工程於六月完成的歷史紀錄
教學假設：名目停留時間與水齡；V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day
教學假設：曲面水平投影的水推力；rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; b=10 m; H=40 m; F=rho g b H2/2/1e6=78.48 MN
教學假設：拱與懸臂剛度分力；ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN
教學假設：岩盤層面有效正向力；N=80 MN; u=0.3 MPa; A=100 m2; phi=30 deg; R=(N-uA)tan(phi)=28.86751 MN
factsEn: The authority reports a Feitsui Dam height of 122.5 m
1987 documented event: Historical record of Feitsui reservoir completion in June
Teaching assumption, Nominal residence and water age: V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day
Teaching assumption, Hydrostatic horizontal projected force: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; b=10 m; H=40 m; F=rho g b H2/2/1e6=78.48 MN
Teaching assumption, Arch and cantilever load sharing: ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN
Teaching assumption, Effective force on rock bedding: N=80 MN; u=0.3 MPa; A=100 m2; phi=30 deg; R=(N-uA)tan(phi)=28.86751 MN
timeline: 1987　翡翠水庫工程於六月完成的歷史紀錄
1994　美國工兵團發布拱壩設計手冊，屬方法文獻年代而非本壩施工日期
2026　本教材核對公開資料並獨立重算假想示例，不是新增工程完工紀錄
timelineEn: 1987 — Historical record of Feitsui reservoir completion in June
1994 — USACE issues its arch-dam design manual; this dates a method reference rather than construction of this dam
2026 — The curriculum checks public evidence and independently recalculates hypothetical examples; this is not a new project completion
codes: 美國工兵團拱壩設計手冊，歷史方法參考
美國墾務局設計標準十四：水壩附屬構造物
codesEn: USACE Arch Dam Design, historical methodological reference
Reclamation Design Standards No. 14: Appurtenant Structures for Dams
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：翡翠水庫大壩
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Feitsui Dam
guides.concept: 翡翠案例結合拱壩的水平傳力與垂直懸臂、基岩層面有效應力、溫度接縫和水庫分層取水。課程將防洪蓄量、溢流消能及原水混合分開建模，避免把水位、濁度和結構安全視為同一指標。每個推導均要求確認幾何、量測基準與不能外推的條件。
guides.conceptEn: The Feitsui case combines horizontal arch transfer and vertical cantilever response with bedding-plane effective stress, thermal joints and stratified withdrawal. Flood storage, spillway dissipation and raw-water mixing are modeled separately so that level, turbidity and structural response are not confused. Each derivation requires explicit geometry, measurement references and limits on extrapolation.
procedure: 供水水庫的體積除以平均取水率得到名目周轉時間，適合比較儲水量與需求尺度。翡翠背景下的真實水齡還取決於密度分層、入流短路及死水區，所以這個商不能代表每滴水都在庫內停留相同天數。 名目時間只包含一個平均流率，若入流沿某深度快速通過，水庫可同時存在很年輕的水團與多年未交換的深層水。
曲面上的水壓始終沿表面法線，水平分力可用垂直投影面積積分取得。翡翠拱壩背景的示範只計一塊假想投影條帶，不把合力直接當作壩基剪力，也不忽略曲面另外可能承受的垂直分量。 積分可用水平分力逐點相加，也可先投影再積分，兩種路徑在靜水條件下應一致，這提供幾何模型的獨立檢核。
雙曲率壩的水平拱作用與垂直懸臂作用共同抵抗水壓。用同位移的兩個並聯彈簧表示這兩條力路，可看出較硬路徑分擔更多荷載，但這只是相容變形概念，不能把兩彈簧視為互不影響的真實壩塊。 總剛度相加來自同位移條件，與串聯彈簧的同力條件不同；分力比恰為剛度比，只在這個線性並聯模型成立。
拱推力進入有層面的岩盤時，抗滑摩擦取決於扣除孔隙水壓後的有效正向力。假想單一平面模型把水壓作用面積明列出來，讓學員看見排水如何改變有效力，而不是把總壓力全部當成可用摩擦來源。 孔壓作用的方向垂直層面，水壓與總正向力使用相同符號約定才能相減；孔壓上升不是直接增加摩擦的壓緊力。
拱壩接縫的相對開合會受到塊體溫度、拘束及水壓共同影響。自由熱伸縮長度可以當作幾何尺度，但不能直接等同實際縫寬；縫面接觸後可能傳力，張開後傳力條件又會改變，形成非線性問題。 若接縫兩側都朝縫面伸長，相對閉合量可能大於單塊伸長；若一起平移則縫寬不變，顯示絕對與相對位移不同。
水庫冷暖水層的密度差提供恢復浮力，取水流速則會拉動界面。以約化重力及密度福祿數比較慣性與浮力，可討論選擇性取水是否容易擾動水層，但實際取水形狀、界面厚度與三維流場仍不可省略。 約化重力只保留密度差造成的浮力尺度，不能用完整重力取代；其平方根與水深共同形成可與流速比較的特徵速度。
颱風期間水量累積取決於入流減放流的時程，水面積把蓄量差轉成水位差。以局部固定面積作近似可快速估計量級，但翡翠的真實地形曲線與隨水位變動的出口能力會使線性估算偏離實況。 局部面積就是庫容對水位的導數，因此固定面積近似只適合變動不大的一段高程；跨越地形突變時應分段處理。
溢流後的高速淺水若轉成低速深水，可透過水躍耗散能量。矩形渠道的動量平衡給出上下游共軛水深，這不代表任意尾水都能穩住水躍；實際消能池還受床面、空氣摻混及側向流動影響。 躍前與躍後流量相同但速度與水深改變，動量函數相等不代表比能相等，兩斷面的比能差才是耗散的量。
流量與懸浮固體質量濃度相乘得到輸入固體的質量率，可把集水區侵蝕與水庫占容問題串連。濁度是光學反應而非質量濃度，翡翠背景的教學不能不經現地校準就把濁度單位直接乘流量。 質量率積分得到的是運輸量，轉成沉積體積還要知道留下比例與乾容重，因而輸砂與庫容測量應分開設計。
不同深度原水混合後，保守溶質濃度由流量加權質量守恆求得。這個概念能教導取水來源比例的重要性，但濁度、藻類與會反應的物質不一定線性混合，不能把保守示蹤物公式套到所有水質指標。 質量守恆以溶質通量為基礎，濃度本身不能直接相加；每股流量權重的總和必須等於一，混合濃度應介於兩來源之間。
procedureEn: Stored volume divided by mean withdrawal gives a nominal turnover scale useful for comparing storage and demand. Actual water age also depends on stratification, short-circuit inflows and stagnant zones, so the quotient does not describe the travel time of every parcel. A nominal time contains only one averaged flow. Rapid passage along one depth can coexist with young water parcels and deep water that exchanges much more slowly, creating a broad age distribution.

Pressure acts normally to a curved surface, while its horizontal component follows integration over the vertical projection. This exercise treats a hypothetical projected strip rather than equating the result to foundation shear or discarding other force components on the curved body. The horizontal force may be integrated from local components or calculated after projection. Under hydrostatic conditions these routes must agree, providing an independent geometric check without assuming a structural load path.

Horizontal arch and vertical cantilever action jointly resist pressure. Parallel springs with a common displacement illustrate why the stiffer load path attracts more force, while remaining an analogy rather than two independent physical blocks of a real double-curvature dam. Adding stiffnesses follows from common displacement, unlike the common force of series springs. The force ratio equals the stiffness ratio only within this linear parallel model, not as a universal dam property.

Thrust entering bedded rock mobilizes friction according to normal force remaining after water pressure is deducted. A single-plane model explicitly includes pressurized area, showing how drainage changes effective force rather than treating total compression as entirely available for friction. Pore pressure acts normal to the bedding plane, so it must use a compatible sign convention with total normal force. Increasing water pressure is not additional clamping force available to mobilize friction.

Relative joint movement responds to block temperature, restraint and hydraulic loading. Free thermal movement provides a geometric scale rather than the actual gap, because contact can transmit force while opening changes the load path and introduces nonlinearity. When both blocks expand toward a joint, relative closure can exceed one block expansion. Common translation leaves gap unchanged, demonstrating why absolute movement and relative aperture are different observables.

Density contrast between warm and cool layers supplies restoring buoyancy while withdrawal velocity disturbs the interface. Reduced gravity and a densimetric Froude number compare inertia with buoyancy, without resolving intake geometry, interface thickness or the three-dimensional withdrawal field. Reduced gravity retains the buoyancy associated with density difference and cannot be replaced by full gravitational acceleration. Combined with depth under a square root, it produces a characteristic velocity comparable with withdrawal speed.

During a storm, storage accumulates from the time history of inflow minus release. Local water area converts volume change into level change as a first approximation, while real geometry and level-dependent outlet behavior can depart from that linear estimate. Local surface area is the derivative of storage with respect to elevation. Constant area is therefore a local approximation, and a level change spanning abrupt topographic variation should be integrated in segments.

A hydraulic jump converts fast shallow flow into slower deeper flow while dissipating energy. Rectangular-channel momentum gives conjugate depths, but arbitrary tailwater will not necessarily hold the jump in place, and actual basins involve aeration, bed details and lateral effects. Discharge is conserved across the jump while depth and velocity change. Equal momentum functions do not imply equal specific energies; their specific-energy difference quantifies the mechanical energy dissipated in the transition.

Discharge times suspended-solids mass concentration gives a solids delivery rate linking catchment erosion to reservoir storage. Turbidity is an optical response rather than mass concentration, so it cannot be multiplied directly by flow without a site-specific conversion and its uncertainty. Integrating mass flux gives transported solids. Conversion to deposited volume additionally requires retention and dry bulk density, so sediment transport measurements and reservoir-capacity surveys address related but distinct quantities.

A conservative dissolved constituent mixes according to flow-weighted mass balance, illustrating the importance of source proportions. Turbidity, algae and reactive substances need not mix linearly, so the tracer equation is not a universal relationship for every water-quality indicator. Mass conservation applies to solute flux rather than concentration alone. Flow weights must sum to unity, and a conservative two-source blend should lie between the source concentrations when both flows are positive.
evidence: 將有效交換體積減為原值七成，計算名目停留時間，再畫完全混合與短路兩種概念流路，說明單一平均數無法分辨何者。
把水深從四十公尺增至四十八公尺，計算合力倍率並比較壓力倍率，解釋為何總推力增加快於底壓，以及投影寬度假設有何影響。
把拱剛度降至二千四百兆牛頓每公尺，重新求兩條分力及共同位移，畫出荷載轉移方向，指出這項結果仍不能判定局部裂縫是否擴展。
把均勻孔壓提高到零點四兆帕，重算摩擦抗力並畫孔壓與抗力關係，再討論何時有效正向力趨近零會使簡化接觸假設失效。
畫兩側等長塊體同時升溫的幾何圖，指定固定端位置後求相對位移，再與單側伸長比較，說明接縫初始間隙對是否接觸的影響。
evidenceEn: Reduce the actively exchanging volume to seventy percent, recalculate turnover and sketch complete mixing and short-circuit pathways. Explain why the same nominal mean cannot distinguish their very different age distributions.

Increase depth from forty to forty-eight metres, compare force and bottom-pressure multipliers, and explain why resultant force grows faster. State how the assumed projected width limits the interpretation of the comparison.

Reduce arch stiffness to twenty-four hundred meganewtons per metre, recalculate both forces and displacement, and draw redistribution. Explain why these results alone cannot determine whether a local crack will propagate.

Raise uniform pore pressure to zero point four megapascals, recalculate resistance and plot its pressure dependence. Discuss why the contact assumption breaks down as effective normal force approaches zero.

Sketch two equal blocks warming together, specify their fixed ends and derive relative movement. Compare it with single-block expansion and explain how the initial gap determines whether contact develops.
pitfalls: 以整座水庫體積計算後宣稱污染會在該天數全部消失，忽略長尾水齡與沉積再釋出；短路可能讓部分新入流水更早抵達取水口，兩種偏差可同時存在。
認為一條力路變軟只會減少整體受力，漏掉荷載向另一力路轉移；若仍保留原分力卻改用新剛度，則位移不相容，模型已失去共同變形的基本前提。
把自由伸長全數加到縫寬而不考慮方向，可能把閉合預測成張開；若縫面已接觸仍用同一直線關係外推，就會忽略接觸壓力與剛度突然改變。
只用暴雨峰值流量乘整場歷時會放大蓄量；反之以日平均淹沒短時洪峰，可能低估最大水位。沒有初始水位的增加量無法判斷剩餘空間是否足夠。
以單一岸邊樣本代表全斷面會漏掉垂向與橫向濃度梯度；把輸入固體全當作永久沉積，也會忽略排出、再懸浮與密度壓密，使庫容損失估算偏離。
pitfallsEn: Claiming that contamination disappears after one nominal residence time ignores long age tails and sediment release. Short circuiting can simultaneously deliver some newly arrived water much earlier to the intake.

Softening one path does not simply remove load; it redirects force into the other path. Keeping old force shares with new stiffnesses creates incompatible displacements and violates the model's central assumption.

Adding all free expansion to gap without checking direction can predict opening where closure occurs. Continuing the same linear relation after contact ignores the resulting contact pressure and abrupt change in stiffness.

Multiplying a storm peak by the whole event overstates volume, while daily averaging can suppress the maximum level. A level increment without the initial elevation cannot establish how much storage space remains.

One bank sample may miss vertical and lateral gradients. Treating all incoming solids as permanent deposition ignores passage, resuspension and compaction, so transported mass cannot directly establish lost reservoir volume.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 石門水庫大壩
related.transfer: 可遷移「名目停留時間與水齡」與「颱風入流與短時水位」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；石門水庫大壩的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Nominal residence and water age" and "Storm inflow and short term level" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Shihmen Dam must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦雙曲率拱壩與原水品質取水；石門水庫大壩則以中央心層土石壩與排砂取水協作為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on double curvature arch support and raw water withdrawal; Shihmen Dam centres on central core embankments with sediment and withdrawal functions, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「名目停留時間與水齡」與「分層心層的串聯滲流」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到石門水庫大壩，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「取水孔口的局部流量」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Nominal residence and water age” and “Series seepage through core layers”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Shihmen Dam, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Local intake orifice discharge", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 翡翠水庫大壩
history.text: 翡翠管理機關列出雙曲率變厚度拱壩形式，壩高一百二十二點五公尺。水利署回顧記載一九八七年六月完工，並描述基礎岩盤處理的工程背景。教材不使用舊有總庫容冒充今日有效庫容，也不把示範材料強度宣稱為工程檢測結果。美國拱壩方法目錄與墾務局附屬構造索引提供研究方向，沒有取代本地正式規範。與石門土石壩的比較用於說明傳力及滲流機制的差異，而非優劣排行。
history.textEn: The reservoir authority identifies a variable-thickness double-curvature arch dam with height 122.5 m. A WRA retrospective records completion in June 1987 and discusses foundation treatment. The course does not substitute historical gross storage for current usable capacity or present assumed strengths as project test results. American arch and appurtenant-structure reference indexes provide research directions rather than applicable local approval criteria. Comparison with Shihmen illustrates differences in load transfer and seepage mechanisms and is not a ranking of the two projects.
